pages.title: Triple 625 mm Heavy Electromagnetic Turret
pages.text: $(br2)A triple-barreled 625 mm heavy electromagnetic turret.$(br2)Each attack fires a three-round burst of massive, electromagnetically propelled armor-piercing shells. Functions only on a subspace.

Once linked to a Control Seat, it supports three modes: Automatic fires at hostile subspaces; Manual uses head-aim control while the player's view is unlocked and waits while view lock is enabled; Smart uses head-aim control while view is unlocked and automatically fires at hostile subspaces while view lock is enabled.
Extremely effective against hostile subspaces, but lacks explosive or area-destruction capability.$(br2)Maximum targeting distance/range: 256 blocks.
